description: This file contains the main source code for a React-based interactive roadmap visualization page, including components for progress indicators, milestones, a dynamic mind map (node-link diagram), and related utility functions. It defines the structure of the roadmap page, its components, and the logic for rendering and interacting with a complex visualization of career milestones, skills, and pathways.

classes.name: RoadmapTab
classes.description: Type for identifying tabs in the roadmap UI ('mindMap' or 'pathway')

classes.name: SkillDelta
classes.description: Represents a skill assessment with current and target proficiency levels

classes.name: MilestoneStatus
classes.description: Type for milestone completion status ('Not started', 'In progress', 'Done')

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Defines a milestone with id, title, date, description, status, tags, and stage

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Structure representing a career role plan with role ID, title, industry, compatibility, skill deltas, and milestones

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Type for skill proficiency states ('Strong', 'Gap', 'In progress')

classes.name: MindMapSubNode
classes.description: Sub-node representing a specific skill or activity under a category in the mind map

classes.name: MindMapCategory
classes.description: Category node grouping related sub-nodes in the mind map

classes.name: MindMapNodeKind
classes.description: Type distinguishing the kinds of nodes in the mind map ('you', 'category', 'sub')

classes.name: MindMapNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the mind map with position, label, and style info

classes.name: MindMapEdge
classes.description: Connection between nodes in the mind map

methods.name: safeParseStringArray

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier with a prefix

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates total milestones, how many are done, in progress, and completion percentage

methods.name: progressRingTone

methods.name: stageIcon

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion

methods.name: useIntersectionReveal

methods.name: ProgressRing

methods.name: TagChip

methods.name: StageNode
methods.description: Visual component representing a stage in the roadmap ('NOW', 'NEAR', 'NEXT')

methods.name: MilestoneCard
methods.description: UI card to display and toggle completion of a milestone

methods.name: PathwayCareerTimeline

methods.name: MindMapTooltip

methods.name: MindMapNodeView
methods.description: Renders individual node in the mind map with interactivity

methods.name: MindMapCanvas3Layer
methods.description: Main interactive component rendering the entire mind map visualization and handling user interactions
